verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents its own Deliverability Insights dashboard, which it describes as an "actionable view" of delivery performance over time, alongside "advanced analytics." The evidence does not show the specific bounce, complaint, and engagement breakdowns, or any guidance on inbox placement or sender reputation. The inbox-placement statement describes delivery infrastructure, not analytics guidance. missing for 10: documented bounce/complaint/engagement metric breakdowns, inbox placement guidance, sender reputation scoring or recommendations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the dashboard.

support.subject: As a deliverability manager, I can see bounce, complaint, and engagement analytics with guidance on inbox placement and sender reputation, not just raw counts

citations.quote: Twilio SendGrid's Deliverability Insights is a streamlined in-app dashboard that provides an actionable view of your email delivery performance over time.
With features like dynamic templates, real-time validation, deliverability insights, and advanced analytics, you gain the control and visibility to manage outcomes at scale.
